title: Holy Places between Makkah and Madinah
categoryChain: Holy Places between Makkah and Madinah
introduction:
HOLY PLACES BETWEEN MECCA AND MEDINA

Out of those holy places which are on the way to Medina from Mecca like

The graves of the martyrs of Fakh near Masjid-e-Taneem

Grave of Abdullah bin Abbas in the Valley of Taif

The grave of Maimunah

The wife of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) which is two farsakhs away from Mecca in Saraf

Graves of Hawwa (s.a.) in Jeddah and Amina in Abawa

Masjide Ghadeer-e-Khum near Juhfah (two to three miles away from Juhfah)

Grave of Abu Zar-e-Ghaffari in Rabza

Graves of the martyrs of Badr in Badr

Grave of Abdullah bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib who was martyred while returning from the Battle of Badr due to severe wounds and is buried in Rawha which is 17 km. away from Medina, we describe some of them in detail
